title: Fourteen Across
subject: four regulars at a Norwich pub stuck all week on 14 across of the Saturday cryptic crossword, until the landlady pulling pints solves it without looking up
caption: Barbershop quartet, classic four-part close harmony. Tenor, lead, baritone and bass singing ringing locked chords, the bass with bom-bom pickups, finger snaps on the backbeat, an old upright pub piano only in the intro. Warm close-mic pub-room sound with natural reverb and tightly tuned chords. Male quartet, the lead carrying the melody, tenor floating above. 112 BPM, B-flat major. Jolly, cheeky and triumphant. No drums, no autotune, no pop production, no rap, no solo diva runs.
lyrics:
[Intro - pub piano then quartet hum]

[Verse 1]
Saturday the paper came
Four of us, the same old game
Pens out, pints poured, off we go
Thirteen down, a cinch, you know

[Pre-Chorus]
Fourteen across, eight letters, oh
Seven words of clue, and no

[Chorus]
Fourteen across, we're lost
Sunday, Monday, gone
Fourteen across, the cost
Is a pint for every one

[Verse 2]
Tuesday Bill rang up his son
Wednesday Ken asked everyone
Thursday Reg wrote it in pen
Wrong, so we began again

[Chorus]
Fourteen across, we're lost
Friday, still a blank
Fourteen across, the cost
Is filling Maureen's bank

[Bridge - bass bom-bom]
Then Maureen, pulling a pint
Never even looks

[Chorus]
Fourteen across, she's right
Spells it slow and calm
Fourteen across tonight
We're buying Maureen's round

[Outro - ringing tag chord]
Next Saturday, the paper's due
Maureen, there's a pen for you
